title: Longitudinal Wheel - Disc Brake
text: 带盘式、鼓式或映射制动器的纵向车轮，输入 8 路、输出 5 路；按 {Rolling Resistance} 指定滚动阻力转矩；{Longitudinal Force} 指定类型 Magic Formula constant、{Brake Type} 指定类型 None、{Vertical Motion} 指定类型 None、{Longitudinal scaling factor, lam_x} 指定摩擦缩放因子、{Input friction scale factor} 指定 off、{Axle viscous damping coefficient, br} 指定阻尼、{Wheel inertia, Iyy} 指定惯性、{Wheel initial angular velocity, omegao} 指定 Wheel speed、{Relaxation length, Lrel}、{Loaded radius, Re}、{Unloaded radius, UNLOADED_RADIUS}、{Nominal longitudinal speed, LONGVL} 指定速度、{Nominal camber angle, gamma} 指定 Camber、{Nominal pressure, NOMPRES} 指定压力、{Pressure, press} 指定压力、{Pure longitudinal peak factor, Dx} 指定 Factor、{Pure longitudinal shape factor, Cx} 指定 Factor、{Pure longitudinal stiffness factor, Bx} 指定 Factor、{Pure longitudinal curvature factor, Ex} 指定 Factor、{Cfx shape factor, PCX1} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal friction at nominal normal load, PDX1} 指定 Factor、{Frictional variation with load, PDX2} 指定 Factor、{Frictional variation with camber, PDX3} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal curvature at nominal normal load, PEX1} 指定 Factor、{Variation of curvature factor with load, PEX2} 指定 Factor、{Variation of curvature factor with square of load, PEX3} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal curvature factor with slip, PEX4} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal slip stiffness at nominal normal load, PKX1} 指定 Factor、{Variation of slip stiffness with load, PKX2} 指定 Factor、{Slip stiffness exponent factor, PKX3} 指定 Factor、{Horizontal shift in slip ratio at nominal normal load, PHX1} 指定 Factor 2.1585E-4、{Variation of horizontal slip ratio with load, PHX2} 指定 Factor、{Vertical shift in load at nominal normal load, PVX1} 指定 Factor 1.5973E-5、{Variation of vertical shift with load, PVX2} 指定 Factor 1.043E-4、{Linear variation of longitudinal slip stiffness with tire pressure, PPX1} 指定 Factor、{Quadratic variation of longitudinal slip stiffness with tire pressure, PPX2} 指定 Factor、{Linear variation of peak longitudinal friction with tire pressure, PPX3} 指定 Factor、{Quadratic variation of peak longitudinal friction with tire pressure, PPX4} 指定 Factor、{Slip speed decay function scaling factor, lam_muV} 指定 Factor、{Brake slip stiffness scaling factor, lam_Kxkappa} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal shape scaling factor, lam_Cx} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal curvature scaling factor, lam_Ex} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal horizontal shift scaling factor, lam_Hx} 指定 Factor、{Longitudinal vertical shift scaling factor, lam_Vx} 指定 Factor、{Slip ratio breakpoints, kappaFx} 指定断点 vector、{Normal force breakpoints, FzFx} 指定断点 vector、{Longitudinal force map, FxMap} 查找表 array、{Velocity independent force coefficient, aMy} 指定速度无关的力系数 84e-4、{Linear velocity force component, bMy} 指定线性速度力分量 6.2e-4、{Quadratic velocity force component, cMy} 指定二次速度力分量 1.6e-4、{Tire pressure exponent, alphaMy} 指定轮胎压力指数、{Normal force exponent, betaMy} 指定法向力指数、{Parasitic losses force, Fpl} 指定寄生力损失、{Rolling resistance constant, Cr} 指定滚动阻力常数 1e-3、{Thermal correction factor, Kt} 指定热修正因子、{Measured temperature, Tmeas} 指定测试期间温度、{Ambient temperature, Tamb} 指定应用环境中的温度、{Input ambient temperature} 指定输入环境温度、{Rolling resistance torque coefficient, QSY1} 指定扭矩系数、{Longitudinal force rolling resistance coefficient, QSY2} 指定力阻力系数、{Linear rotational speed rolling resistance coefficient, QSY3} 指定线性速度系数、{Quartic rotational speed rolling resistance coefficient, QSY4} 指定四次方速度系数 8.5e-05、{Camber squared rolling resistance torque, QSY5} 指定外倾阻力矩、{Load based camber squared rolling resistance torque, QSY6} 指定载荷阻力矩、{Normal load rolling resistance coefficient, QSY8} 指定法向阻力系数、{Pressure load rolling resistance coefficient, QSY8} 指定压力阻力系数、{Rolling resistance scaling factor, lam_My} 指定缩放因子、{Spin axis velocity breakpoints, VxMy} 指定自旋轴速度断点、{Normal force breakpoints, FzMy} 指定法向力断点、{Rolling resistance torque map, MyMap} 指定滚动阻力矩映射 array、{Static friction coefficient, mu_static} 指定静摩擦 .3、{Kinetic friction coefficient, mu_kinetic} 指定动摩擦 .2、{Disc brake actuator bore, disc_abore} 指定缸径距离 .05、{Brake pad mean radius, Rm} 指定半径 .177、{Number of brake pads, num_pads} 指定数量、{Drum brake actuator bore, disc_abore} 指定缸径距离、{Shoe pin to drum center distance, drum_a} 指定距离、{Shoe pin center to force application point distance, drum_c} 指定距离、{Drum internal radius, drum_r} 指定半径、{Shoe pin to pad start angle, drum_theta1} 指定角度、{Shoe pin to pad end angle, drum_theta2} 指定角度、{Brake actuator pressure breakpoints, brake_p_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Wheel speed breakpoints, brake_n_bpt} 指定断点 vector、{Brake torque map, f_brake_t} 查找表 array、{Nominal normal force, FNOMIN} 指定力、{Nominal rated load scaling factor, lam_Fzo} 指定 Factor、{Wheel and unsprung mass, m} 指定质量、{Initial deflection, zo} 指定挠度、{Initial velocity, zdoto} 指定速度、{Gravitational acceleration, g} 指定重力、{Ground displacement, Gndz} 指定位移、{Vertical deflection breakpoints, zFz} 指定断点、{Pressure breakpoints, pFz} 指定断点、{Force due to deflection, Fzz} 指定力、{Vertical velocity breakpoints, zdotFz} 指定断点、{Force due to velocity, Fzzdot} 指定力、{Minimum normal force, FZMIN} 指定最小法向力、{Maximum normal force, FZMAX} 指定最大法向力、{Max allowable slip ratio (absolute), kappamax} 指定比值、{Velocity tolerance used to handle low velocity situations, VXLOW} 指定容差、{Minimum ambient temperature, TMIN} 指定最低环境温度、{Maximum ambient temperature, TMAX} 指定最高环境温度，按实例取值。
